title: Winged orange glowing beings over skywatch groups

tellings.quote: And we get things that appear to have wings, orange glowing beings, as many as 20 at the time, fly 25 ft over our head

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs seem to show up around him, hosts skywatches, night gatherings where people watch the sky together. On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, he says that at these gatherings in recent years they have seen orange glowing beings that seem to have wings, as many as 20 at once, flying about 25 feet over their heads. If true, it would mean the visitors come close to whole groups of people on purpose.
